data.description: The ranger becomes thin and hyperactive, his movements taking on a nervous spryness. While in this form, the ranger can spend a move action to move up to 1/2 his speed without provoking attacks of opportunity.|!PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Shapeshifter ~ Master Shifter

raw_tokens.value: Shifter's Blessing ~ Form of the Jackal

The ranger becomes thin and hyperactive, his movements taking on a nervous spryness. While in this form, the ranger can spend a move action to move up to 1/2 his speed without provoking attacks of opportunity.|!PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Shapeshifter ~ Master Shifter

The ranger becomes thin and hyperactive, his movements taking on a nervous spryness. While in this form, the ranger does not provoke attacks of opportunity due to movement. Alternatively, the ranger can polymorph into the form of a jackal or other canine creature as if the caster of beast shape IV.|PREABILITY:1,CATEGORY=Special Ability,Shapeshifter ~ Master Shifter
